Water & clean energy / HISTORICAL PROJECT

Water that reaches home.

D2Re-B · Baveli, Wayanad

A solar-powered water system developed with the community, combining pumping, storage, drinking water filtration and street lighting.

The need

Residents relied on a nearby river for daily water collection.

The response

Solar-powered pumping and filtration bring water closer to the community.

Local ownership

Local SIGHT student volunteers supported monitoring and maintenance.
